Name: Dynamite Fishing
Author: smallerpoorer
Description:
✨ 核心功能 (Features)[b]💥 炸弹钓鱼 (Explosive Fishing)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]支持炸弹[/b]：挂载 [b]樱桃炸弹[/b]、[b]炸弹[/b] 或 [b]超级炸弹[/b]。
[*][b]威力至上[/b]：炸弹越强，爆炸范围越大，炸出来的鱼越多！
[*][b]变废为宝[/b]：炸鱼时，垃圾（眼镜、CD等）有概率被炸成 [b]蟹笼产物[/b]（龙虾、螃蟹等）。
[/list][b]⚡ 电池电鱼 (Electric Fishing)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]高压作业[/b]：挂载 [b]电池组[/b] 进行高压电鱼。
[*][b]美味熏鱼[/b]：电熟的鱼会直接变成 [b]熏鱼 (Smoked Fish)[/b]，价格翻倍且保留品质！
[*][b]高压碳化[/b]：电击会将钓到的垃圾直接碳化为 [b]煤炭 (Coal)[/b]。
[/list][b]⚖️ 天谴系统 (Karma System)[/b]
[list]
[*]当你通过炸鱼/电鱼累计捕获 [b]100[/b] 条战利品时，将会触发 [b]“天降正义”[/b]。
[*][i]提示：请留意头顶的乌云……[/i]
[/list][quote][b]PS: 并不是每一条鱼都能捡到的哦[/b][/quote][line]⚠️ 重要提示：防止炸弹消失 (IMPORTANT WARNING)[b]请务必阅读，防止操作失误导致物品丢失！[/b]
由于原版游戏 UI 的底层限制，如果您直接拖拽一个新的炸弹去 [b]覆盖/替换[/b] 鱼竿上已有的炸弹，可能会导致其中一个炸弹直接消失。
❌ [b]错误操作 (WRONG)[/b]：直接拖拽新炸弹覆盖旧炸弹。✅ [b]正确操作 (RIGHT)[/b]：请养成好习惯，先 [b]右键点击[/b] 鱼竿取下旧炸弹，空出插槽后，再放上新的炸弹。
[line]💬 测试与反馈 (Feedback)本模组目前处于测试阶段，可能尚未覆盖所有游戏场景。如果您在使用过程中遇到任何 Bug 或异常，欢迎在评论区留言反馈，我会尽快查看并修复。感谢您的支持！

✨ Features[b]💥 Explosive Fishing[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Ammo Types[/b]: Attach [b]Cherry Bombs[/b], [b]Bombs[/b], or [b]Mega Bombs[/b] to your fishing rod.
[*][b]More Power[/b]: Stronger bombs = larger radius = more fish!
[*][b]Trash into Treasure[/b]: Explosions have a chance to turn trash items (CDs, glasses) into [b]Crab Pot loot[/b] (Lobsters, Crabs, etc.).
[/list][b]⚡ Electric Fishing[/b]
[list]
[*][b]High Voltage[/b]: Attach [b]Battery Packs[/b] to electrocute the water.
[*][b]Smoked Delicacies[/b]: Caught fish are instantly cooked into [b]Smoked Fish[/b] (2x Value, quality preserved!).
[*][b]Carbonization[/b]: Trash items caught by electricity are instantly turned into [b]Coal[/b].
[/list][b]⚖️ Karma System[/b]
[list]
[*]Nature is watching! When you catch a total of [b]100[/b] items via explosions or electricity, you will trigger [b]"Divine Punishment"[/b].
[*][i]Warning: Watch out for lightning...[/i]
[/list][quote][b]PS: Not every single fish is guaranteed to be picked up![/b][/quote][line]⚠️ IMPORTANT WARNING: Prevent Item Loss[b]Please read this to avoid losing your bombs![/b]
Due to limitations in the vanilla game UI, if you drag and drop a new stack of bombs directly onto the bombs already attached to your rod, [b]items may vanish[/b].
❌ [b]WRONG[/b]: Dragging new bombs to replace old ones directly.✅ [b]RIGHT[/b]: Always [b]Right-Click[/b] your rod to remove the old bombs first, then attach the new ones.
[line]💬 Beta & FeedbackThis mod is currently in [b]Beta[/b]. If you encounter any bugs or unexpected behavior, please leave a comment in the "Posts" or "Bugs" tab. I will check and fix them as soon as possible. Thank you for your support!
